title: Sparrow's smuggling side-quest ('The Grain Run') still frames the job purely as dodging 'the Regent taking four in ten' with no acknowledgment that I had, minutes earlier at the almonry, already persuaded Sister Winnow to turn that same tithe barn into a common store open to all, worthy or not.
where: The Back Lane (talk to Sparrow: 'run the sacks past the tithe')
